content.comment_body: Hi, [product_name] won't open on Windows 7 unless I run it in Windows XP SP3 compatibility mode. Even then, the software freezes each time I attempt to save a file. I've encountered this with both [product_name] V6.0 and the demo version of [product_name] V7.0. Appreciate any assistance.
Upgrade to [product_name] V7 (available for free on the [company_name] website). Note that the file settings are not write protected. Find the file, right-click on it for options.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report problems running [product_name] on Windows 7, with the application only opening in XP SP3 compatibility mode and still freezing when saving files. This affects both version 6.0 and the demo of version 7.0, highlighting persistent compatibility and stability issues with the software on Windows 7.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to function correctly and reliably on Windows 7, particularly to open, run, save, and access files without crashes or compatibility problems.
pain_keywords: unable to save or open files
